title: Network Participation Agreements: Aging of Overpayments and the Share Withheld from Claim Payment Runs
content:
**Aging rule for claim payment runs.** Cascade may continue recovering an overpayment from the claim payment runs of an agreement under the **Network Participation Agreements** that is paid by claim payments rather than by capitation. The run aging adjustment to the continuing run withholding share is set by how many days the overpayment under recovery is past its refund window:

- more than 30 days past adds one share point for every whole 3 days past the window;
- more than 10 and at most 30 days past adds a flat 4 share points;
- 10 days past or fewer adds nothing.

## Measuring the days

- **The overpayment under recovery** is the overpayment that the agreement's most recent withholding was applied to. Where two ledger entries share the latest date, the one listed first on the agreement's ledger is taken.
- **Days past the window** are the days from that overpayment's notice date to today, less the refund window of 45 calendar days.
- **Counting.** Days are calendar days counted from the earlier date to the later date: the earlier date is not counted and the later date is.
- **Top band.** In the top band the points are the number of whole 3-day periods in all the days past the window. A remainder of 1 or 2 days adds nothing.

## Boundary table (hypothetical)

| Notice date to today | Days past the window | Share points added |
|---|---|---|
| 55 days | 10 | None |
| 56 days | 11 | 4 |
| 75 days | 30 | 4 |
| 76 days | 31 | 10 |
| 100 days | 55 | 18 |
